48.19.3  (November 2026)  SECURITY RULES 47 (MEETINGS AND PRAYER GROUPS)
  Online Giving → Copy Security Rules / Make Giving Page Files give rules version 47, the same as Website Update 74 (meetings
  taken on the phone, prayer groups, urgent prayer requests). Publishing the rules from here no longer takes those away.
  Nothing else changed.

apps.name: Beacon Secretary
apps.whats_new:
v4.37.0 - VISITORS GET THEIR OWN PORTAL
  - Meetings… → Visitors (new tab): every visitor with the meetings they were ticked present at and their Sundays. Those who
    came 2 or more times are marked "ready for a sign-in" (the tab shows how many). Select them and click "Give the selected
    their own portal (Member ID and PIN)…": each becomes a member (the Visitors list keeps them, marked "Became member"),
    gets a prayer category, a Member ID and a PIN, and the PIN slips open to print and hand over. Their portal is the same as
    any member's. Their details (contact, birthday …) can be completed later in Members.
  - The phones' list is sent again at once, so they are ticked as members from then on.
